### The Surrounding Lord
Author: Stuart Briscoe (One Year Devotions for Men)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-surrounding-lord-one-year-devotions-for-men-august-6.html
Passage: Psalm 125:2
Points:
- Ancient pilgrims traveling uphill to Jerusalem sang songs of ascents to maintain their focus on God.
- The mountains encircling Jerusalem served as a visible reminder that the Lord surrounds and protects His people.
- Divine protection does not grant immunity from hardship, but guarantees God presides over believers during trials.
- Evil powers will not maintain permanent dominion over the righteous, while crooked paths lead to banishment.
- Believers can experience lasting peace and quiet confidence knowing their ultimate security rests in the Lord.

### Trust God to Endure
Author: Margaret D. Mitchell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/trust-god-to-endure-god-s-love-at-work-week-of-october-19.html
Passage: Psalm 125:1-2
Points:
- Followers of Christ inevitably face seasons of difficulty and pain that test their reliance on God's promises.
- Just as Jerusalem is encircled by mountains, God acts as an unshakable foundation and hedge of protection for His people.
- Biblical trust is a conscious choice to believe God's truth above feelings, fear, and human reasoning.
- Surrendering self-righteous solutions allows God to bring spiritual growth, wisdom, and peace through every trial.
